subject: New vendor setup - Delta Packaging Co
text:
Hi AP,

Procurement approved Delta Packaging Co as a new corrugated supplier (contract signed 11/4). Attached are their W-9, certificate of insurance, and bank letter on their bank's letterhead. Please set them up in the vendor master so we can pay their first invoice on Net 30.

From the bank letter:
Delta Packaging Co
Fifth Third Bank, routing 042000314, account 7730 1182 0456

Thanks,
Steve
label: ordinary
note: Borderline: brand-new vendor onboarding with bank details. There is no existing payment destination being changed, so it is vendor setup rather than a change request. Labeled ordinary; it still deserves its own verification in real life.
